frame: 1600x900 SVG farm; HTML panels in letterbox margins
reference: Existing public/assets/gates sheep, wooden gates and independent scenery SVGs
provenance: Project-authored React/SVG accents. The dog prop is derived from the established PitsiIllustration charcoal/tan standing dog; the gearbox was replaced by a stylized vintage truck H-pattern shifter. No external art or raster generation.

assets.purpose: Vintage H-pattern shifter with a fixed position for each gate, retained selection and pause-aware neutral-channel movement
Personality without changing routes or collisions
Reuse standalone grass and flower art in different arrangements
Readable gate status with symbols and motion alternatives
Use the established charcoal/tan standing dog instead of the mismatched cream cartoon

verification: 55 unit tests and all 31 browser tests passed. Inspected Pitsi and the H-pattern shifter at 1024x600 and six-/nine-gate farms at 1440x900, plus the active nine-gate farm at 1024x600. Asset loading, route/gate coordinates, pause/reduced motion, selected-slot persistence, migration and unclipped layouts were verified. Vector art needs no raster alpha/palette normalization. Further physical-key fun testing remains appropriate.
